answer: The drop in Hardware revenue from Q2 to Q3 2025 was driven by decreases across all listed products. For example, Lattice Ridge fell from 482,955.27 in Q2 to 127,995.04 in Q3, Cascade Beacon dropped from 459,070.15 to 136,043.38, and Nimbus Quartz decreased from 404,436.93 to 116,734.45.
